scope: Separate review of selected graph implications. Source hashes and quotation matches checked separately. Not human adjudication or exhaustive historical verification.

findings.target: F2/F3 anonymous reply and Sodom scope
findings.reason: Keep the unnamed plural respondents and their singular addressee. Attribute the identification as Sages to its editions and commentators. The Sodom-only scope is an interpretation supported by context and commentary, not an explicit noun in the reply.
Two voices agreeing does not make them the same speaker. The named parallel respondent remains in that work; it does not fill the Bavli’s unnamed group.

findings.target: F11–F15 nested stories and legal or verse categories
findings.reason: Keep narrated people, collective groups, verse categories, personified robbery and speaking animals distinguishable. The framing sage reports an exegesis; that does not place the sage inside Noah’s story. Kinship inside the story remains textual evidence.

findings.target: F5/F6 source variants and translation discrepancy
findings.reason: Keep each version’s list of generations. A translation that interprets both differently must not overwrite the adjacent Hebrew or be counted as independent confirmation.
